A data de cada lei é a do título; quando o título não traz, vale o ano do número ou a data da publicação. executivo.nota_en: We counted the laws the city government published in the “Diário Oficial MS (Assomasul)” (an Official Gazette), using the site's advanced filter (city, title “lei” and dates), from January 1, 2025 to October 27, 2026: 137 ordinary and complementary laws, each number once (republications, corrections and annexes are not counted again; bills, decrees and notices that only mention a law are left out). The list does not say who published each law: the few laws the City Council promulgates itself are left out only when the title says “promulgada” (promulgated). 5 of the 142 law numbers in the period do not appear in the Gazette. 1 law numbered outside the main sequence (a typo or a separate numbering) is not counted. Each law's date is the one in its title; when the title has none, the year in its number or the publication date is used. The number of vetoes is left out: a veto is sent to the City Council, and the city government does not publish all of them in the Gazette with numbering that can be checked.
